visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a vertical split-screen. The top half shows a woman in a gym raising her arms, while the bottom half features a woman with dark hair leaning her head on her hand, looking weary and uninspired. (2) A quick montage follows, showing the woman in the gym performing heavy weightlifting and then cycling outdoors under a bright sky. (3) The scene shifts to a bright indoor living room. The main woman is lounging on a green sofa, eating chips from a bag and scrolling through her smartphone. Behind her, a young girl in a checkered dress is energetically dancing and jumping. (4) Close-up shots of the woman reacting to her phone screen are intercut with shots of the girl's enthusiastic dancing. The lighting is warm and domestic. (5) A digital screen capture of a mobile app interface is displayed, showing a 'heart system' personality test with heart rate graphs and colorful icons like 'Sun Heart' and 'Ocean Heart'. (6) Three females (the woman and two younger girls) sit together on the sofa, all looking at their phones with curiosity and excitement. A man briefly walks by in the background hallway. (7) The main woman stands up and starts jogging in place in the living room while looking at her phone. (8) The final phase shows the three females posing together, holding their smartphones toward the camera to display their different personality test results, smiling brightly.
